phase_1.title: Phase 1 · AA-12 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 74 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 74 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 457 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the smooth bore and accelerates to 350 m/s (2750 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Open-Bolt Slam & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the AA-12 staged for its 300 RPM (constant-recoil full-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪：1972 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 由马克斯韦尔·阿奇森首创并经 MPS 全不锈钢重构的 AA-12 采用“恒定后坐”（Constant Recoil）长行程浮空复进原理：重型枪机后坐到底前即被长导气弹簧柔和刹停，绝不撞击机匣尾壁，使全自动 12 号连发后坐力降至传统霰弹枪一成。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：AA-12 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1972 年问世的 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 由美国军警系统公司（Military Police Systems）主导研制，定位为经典的恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪。AA-12 历经 18 年 188 处工程迭代，最终实现了全自动发射 12 号重弹仍能单手平稳控枪的机械奇迹。
由马克斯韦尔·阿奇森首创并经 MPS 全不锈钢重构的 AA-12 采用“恒定后坐”（Constant Recoil）长行程浮空复进原理：重型枪机后坐到底前即被长导气弹簧柔和刹停，绝不撞击机匣尾壁，使全自动 12 号连发后坐力降至传统霰弹枪一成。 整件装备总长 991 mm（39.0 in）、空重 5.2 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1972 年，美国军警系统公司（Military Police Systems）推出了划时代的美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪。AA-12 历经 18 年 188 处工程迭代，最终实现了全自动发射 12 号重弹仍能单手平稳控枪的机械奇迹。 它的核心设计聚焦于恒定后坐原理让枪机全程浮空运动而不撞击机匣尾部，后坐峰值锐减，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「开膛提前底火击发（API）恒定后坐长行程导气 · 20 发圆鼓」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用416R 精密拉丝不锈钢精加工而成。300 发/分节奏化射速既可单发点射也可持续扫射 20 发大容量圆鼓，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 采用开膛提前底火击发（API）恒定后坐长行程导气 · 20 发圆鼓。在每个击发周期中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环。借助416R 精密拉丝不锈钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了300 发/分节奏化射速既可单发点射也可持续扫射 20 发大容量圆鼓。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) 弹药规格与 457 mm（18 in 不锈钢滑膛身管 · 耐腐蚀免润滑内腔），最高工作膛压约 74 MPa，可赋予弹头 350 m/s 的出膛初速与 2,750 J 动能，有效作用距离达 100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.5 mm 不锈钢重型滑膛身管，支持 12 号鹿弹与尾翼稳定 FRAG-12 榴弹。同时，全不锈钢大间隙内部机构号称免涂润滑油可连续射击数千发无故障，令其在 300 发/分（恒定低后坐连发） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 457 毫米身管与 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) 口径，美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 实现了每秒 350 米的初速与 100 米有效射程。18.5 mm 不锈钢重型滑膛身管，支持 12 号鹿弹与尾翼稳定 FRAG-12 榴弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与 22 mm 膛轴设计，美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 19.6 N·s 水平。直通式枪托把膛线轴心与抵肩点拉成一线，彻底抑制全自动枪口上跳。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-77）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与出色的整体工效，直通式枪托把膛线轴心与抵肩点拉成一线，彻底抑制全自动枪口上跳。欢迎在 BAY-77 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun: The 1972 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Pioneered by Maxwell Atchisson and rebuilt in stainless steel by MPS, the AA-12 uses open-bolt Advanced Primer Ignition and a long-travel constant-recoil spring that arrests bolt carrier travel before striking the rear receiver wall, enabling controllable one-handed full-auto 12-gauge fire. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-77.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the AA-12
paragraphs: Introduced in 1972 by Military Police Systems (MPS) in United States, the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun emerged as a defining Constant-Recoil Automatic Shotgun. Refined through 188 engineering revisions over 18 years, the AA-12 achieved the rare mechanical feat of controllable full-automatic 12-gauge fire from an open bolt.

Pioneered by Maxwell Atchisson and rebuilt in stainless steel by MPS, the AA-12 uses open-bolt Advanced Primer Ignition and a long-travel constant-recoil spring that arrests bolt carrier travel before striking the rear receiver wall, enabling controllable one-handed full-auto 12-gauge fire. Measuring 991 mm (39.0 in) at an unloaded weight of 5.2 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1972, Military Police Systems (MPS) of United States introduced the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun. Refined through 188 engineering revisions over 18 years, the AA-12 achieved the rare mechanical feat of controllable full-automatic 12-gauge fire from an open bolt. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Constant-recoil kinematics arrest the bolt carrier before hitting the rear wall — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun sits its Open-Bolt Advanced Primer Ignition (API) Constant-Recoil · 20-Round Drum. Throughout every firing cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia, containing 74 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in precision-machined 416R stainless steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 300 RPM controllable cadence allows trigger-finger singles or 20-round drum bursts, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun relies on Open-Bolt Advanced Primer Ignition (API) Constant-Recoil · 20-Round Drum. During each cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia. Machined from precision-machined 416R stainless steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 300 RPM controllable cadence allows trigger-finger singles or 20-round drum bursts.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) with 457 mm (18 in Stainless Steel Smoothbore · Dry-Run Internals), the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun develops 350 m/s muzzle velocity and 2,750 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 100 meters.

Internally, 18.5 mm stainless smoothbore supporting buckshot, slugs, and fin-stabilized FRAG-12 grenades. Combined with its 300 RPM (constant-recoil full-auto) tempo, Stainless steel loose-tolerance internals operate reliably without lubrication, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) through its 457 millimeter bore, the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun achieves 350 meters per second and 100 meters of effective reach. 18.5 mm stainless smoothbore supporting buckshot, slugs, and fin-stabilized FRAG-12 grenades.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round high-capacity drum magazine body with a 22 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 19.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. In-line straight-stock bore geometry neutralizes full-auto muzzle climb.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-77), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 20-round high-capacity drum magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, In-line straight-stock bore geometry neutralizes full-auto muzzle climb. Explore BAY-77 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun.

zh.craftAndMaterial: 采用416R 精密拉丝不锈钢制造，表面按1972年代军警系统公司（Military Police Systems）军械标准精整，兼顾耐磨与防蚀。
zh.kinematicRole: 与相邻模块保持精密基准配合，协同支撑 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) 发射周期中的定位、操持与可靠复位。
zh.designHighlight: 工程亮点呼应整枪特征：300 发/分节奏化射速既可单发点射也可持续扫射 20 发大容量圆鼓。
zh.audioScript: T-02，硬化击锤/平移击针击发组件。作为 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪 的关键构件，它采用416R 精密拉丝不锈钢制造，主要承担高速释放储能精确击发底火/弓弦职能。与相邻模块保持精密基准配合，协同支撑 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75" · FRAG-12) 发射周期中的定位、操持与可靠复位。

en.overview: Hardened Hammer / Striker Unit (T-02) of the MPS AA-12 Atchisson Auto-Shotgun, serving as the dedicated high-speed ignition impactor node within the 20-part assembly.

Maintains datum alignment with adjacent AA-12 assemblies throughout recoil, extraction, and return to battery.

zh.overview: 美国 AA-12 恒定后坐全自动霰弹枪（T-03）的主击发扭簧/螺旋打击簧，隶属 20 件套标准装配体系，负责为可靠击发提供充沛冲击能量。
